summary: Build practical harassment prevention, investigation, and compliance skills through legal frameworks, risk tools, and workplace case exercises. Enrol today.
lede: Harassment prevention training helps HR, employee-relations and investigation teams, and people managers handle reports consistently. It develops skills in assessing psychosocial risks, setting up reporting pathways, and planning fair investigations with reliable evidence. Learners also practise confidentiality controls and corrective-action tracking, using case trends to inform prevention.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage workplace conduct, employee concerns, investigations, risk controls, or organizational reporting. It suits intermediate practitioners who already handle people processes and need a more consistent legal and operational approach to harassment prevention.
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to HR, employee relations, compliance, people management, workplace investigations, occupational health and safety, or legal advisory processes. You should be able to review workplace policies and handle confidential information. No programming is required. Advanced legal interpretation is introduced conceptually, while policy assessment, risk mapping, investigation planning, and dashboard exercises use an operational application level.
